metadata.case_name: LEUNG CHOI PING v. LEUNG KING CHOI AND ANOTHER

plaintiff.occupation_after: fit for light duty jobs, such as cashier and car park attendant

source: Chest X-ray showed fractured right 8th rib and right clavicle.
Chest X-ray showed fractured right 8th rib and right clavicle.

injuries.description: deep laceration at the right lobe of the liver; right hemihepatectomy performed
source: The surgical team found 2 litres of blood in the Plaintiff’s abdominal cavity and a deep laceration at the right lobe of the liver. Right hemihepatectomy was done to stop the severe bleeding.

injuries.description: haemoperitoneum (2 litres of blood in the abdominal cavity)
source: The surgical team found 2 litres of blood in the Plaintiff’s abdominal cavity and a deep laceration at the right lobe of the liver.

injuries.description: encephalopathy with mild elevation of blood ammonia
source: After the operation, the Plaintiff had encephalopathy with mild elevation of blood ammonia and developed sputum retention and pneumonia.
After the operation, the Plaintiff had encephalopathy with mild elevation of blood ammonia and developed sputum retention and pneumonia.
Chest X-ray showed bilateral pleural effusion.
She received hemihepatectomy and later developed ankle edema and pleural effusion.
injuries.icd_description: Injuries to the ankle or foot

injuries.description: kneecap cartilage injury (probable concomitant injury to left knee)
source: The Plaintiff probably sustained concomitant injury to her left knee, which resulted in the kneecap cartilage injury.
injuries.icd_description: Other specified injuries to the knee or lower leg

injuries.description: multiple scars including a 23 cm midline abdominal surgical scar and 2 hypertrophic scars over the anterior aspect of the left knee
source: There were multiple scars over the body.
There was a 23 cm surgical scar over the midline of the abdomen with tenderness over left the costal margin.
There were 2 hypertrophic scars over the anterior aspect of the left knee but no swelling or effusion.
injuries.icd_description: Other specified superficial injury of abdomen, lower back or pelvis

injuries.description: muscle wasting of the left leg
source: There was muscle wasting of the left leg.
injuries.icd_description: Injury of other specified muscle, fascia, tendon or bursa at lower leg level

injuries.description: right shoulder injury with limited movement
source: Movement of the right shoulder was limited.
The Plaintiff’s right shoulder pain and tenderness is compatible with the shoulder injury she sustained during the accident.
injuries.icd_description: Strain or sprain of shoulder joint

manifestations.description: pain, tenderness and bruises over her right chest wall and the right side of her abdomen
movement of the right shoulder was limited
muscle wasting of the left leg
full flexion of the left knee causes pain
2 hypertrophic scars over the anterior aspect of the left knee
23 cm surgical scar over the midline of the abdomen with tenderness over left the costal margin
encephalopathy with mild elevation of blood ammonia
some depression and developed chronic anxiety as a result of her traumatic experience
tenderness over both patello-femoral joints with crepitation on knee-bending

treatments_received: treatment in general surgical ward and medical ward
follow up treatment at the Surgical Outpatient Clinic and the Orthopaedics Clinic
treatments_future: follow up with a hepatologist every 6 months

losses.description: Right hemihepatectomy; fractured right 8th rib and right clavicle; kneecap cartilage injury
Multiple scars including a 23 cm midline abdominal surgical scar and 2 hypertrophic scars over the anterior aspect of the left knee
Should avoid activities that involve frequent bending of her knee joint, such as squatting, kneeling and stairs climbing; movement of the right shoulder was limited
Some depression and developed chronic anxiety as a result of her traumatic experience
The Plaintiff is not fit to return to her pre-accident job, although she is fit for light duty jobs, such as cashier and car park attendant.
